name: Gelato x Fat & Weird | 200mg Cookie | Pitchen Tents
description: Introducing a first of its kind edible collab between Gelato Canna x Fat & Weird Cookie!! Our Pitchen Tents cookie is enrobed in distillate infused chocolate and it's made with a chocolate lava cake base, fudge core, with mini chocolate chips, Hershey kisses mixins, topped with powdered sugar.
